record.name: Vanuatu
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. In August 2026 Vanuatu said it is arranging to develop a National AI Strategy and called for binding consent protections for traditional knowledge in the regional AI framework.

related_bodies.name: Office of the Government Chief Information Officer / Department of Communication and Digital Transformation
related_bodies.role: It is a government digital agency that led the Digital Transformation Masterplan; no AI evaluation role was found.

related_bodies.name: Pacific Islands Forum (regional AI principles and planned governance framework)
related_bodies.role: Leaders endorsed regional AI principles in September 2026 and a regional AI Governance Framework is to be considered in 2027; this is a regional process, not a national body.

next_check.reason: Whether a national AI strategy or any national AI evaluation body is adopted.

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.

Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. Recorded English and national or official-language queries and retrieved primary governance evidence support medium confidence. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

searches.query: Vanuatu national AI safety institute advanced model evaluation government

check.language_note: English is an official language or an official language of national administration; it is a practical national search language for this check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: The government statement and regional UNDP readiness discussion do not establish two substantive institute-status evidence origins. Confidence was low under that rule; none_identified is a bounded search finding, not proof of absence.
check.governance_note: The government's account states that Vanuatu is procuring development of its National AI Strategy and asks regional assistance to complement national work already underway. The governance finding rests on that country-specific procurement, not on participation in the Pacific principles or the Standards Australia regional project.

record.notes: The strategy statement rests on a newspaper report of the delegation's speech (secondary); the PMO release on the same speech was only partly readable. Vanuatu is one of six governments in the Standards Australia responsible-AI project. English and French-term searches.
